["Q06","A Speed-enabled mech entering a territory with enemy workers only stops and cannot move again that turn; enemy workers immediately retreat to their home base, leaving resources. ["Q11","Build a structure on a controlled territory with your worker; Factory is allowed, lakes and home bases forbidden. ["Q12","Put an enlisted recruit permanently on any open one-time bonus space on your Faction Mat; immediately gain two power, two coins, two popularity, or two combat cards. ["Q13","Both secretly and simultaneously choose dial power from 0 to min(7,current power), and may add up to one combat card per participating character/mech (plus Rusviet People's Army one extra card if any workers present). ["Q14","Loser's all characters, mechs and workers retreat to own home base, leaving all resources on battle territory; Nordic Seaworthy can instead retreat eligible units/carried workers to adjacent lakes. ["Q15","After all combats, resolve encounter if character remains in token territory; if contested entry is lost, character retreats and token stays. Gains go to encounter territory. ["Q16","Each player's character, on its first finish of a Move action at Factory (after winning any combat), looks at available Factory cards, chooses one, returns the rest; each player gets at most one permanent card and later visits cannot exchange. ["Q17","Only on your own turn, before or after a top/bottom action, reveal a completed objective; you may wait but must meet all requirements at reveal. ["Q18","Stars for six upgrades, four mechs, four structures, four recruits, all eight workers on board, one revealed completed objective, combat victory (up to two stars), 18 popularity, or 16 power. ["Q19","If bottom action earns sixth star, collect primary benefit, coins, and your ongoing recruit benefit before placing star. ["Q20","At popularity 10 (tier 7–12), 5 stars add $20; four normal territories plus Factory count as 7 locations (Factory counts 3), adding $21; 13 resources make 6 complete pairs, adding $12. ["Q21","Home base is not a territory and normally cannot be entered, built on, or deployed on; setup and forced retreats are exceptions, as is Crimea Wayfare when unlocked. ["Q22","Mountain→metal, tundra→oil, farm→food, forest→wood, village→worker; lake and Factory produce nothing. Workers are not resources. Resource supply has no limit; use multipliers if needed.","Produce terrain table; resources section.","supported"],
["Q23","All units may pick up, carry and drop any number of resources during movement; mechs can carry workers but never character. ["Q24","Any unit may enter an enemy-structure-only territory and take control without combat. All printed tunnel territories are adjacent for movement by any unit.","Enemy structure only; tunnels.","supported"],
["Q25","Never pay a partial cost. If unable to afford any action, take a dead turn: move token to a different section and take neither action. Since last used Move, choose any different section.","Turn Structure.","supported"],
["Q26","Armory grants +1 power on Trade; Monument grants +1 popularity on Bolster. These are built-structure benefits for corresponding future actions. ["Q27","Riverwalk is an unlockable mech ability for all factions, including Nordic; it lets character and all mechs cross rivers onto faction-specific terrain: Nordic/Saxony forests and mountains; Rusviet farms and villages; Crimea farms and tundra; Polania villages and mountains. It does not apply to workers. ["Q28","Saxony Underpass: controlled mountains and all tunnels, including own Mine, are adjacent for character/mech Move. Rusviet Township: controlled villages and Factory are adjacent for character/mech Move. Workers cannot use these shortcuts.","Other unlocked mech abilities.","supported"],
["Q29","Saxony Disarm applies before combat on a tunnel or own Mine: opponent loses two power on track, once per combat, not per unit. ["Q30","Rusviet People's Army adds one card total in combat if at least one worker is present; two mechs and three workers therefore allow three cards (two for mechs, plus one). Workers alone never fight.","Rusviet People's Army; components/combat.","supported"],
["Q31","Crimea Wayfare lets character/mechs move from a territory or home base to your own or any inactive faction home base regardless of distance, including inactive expansion bases. Cannot enter an active opponent's base.","Crimea Wayfare.","supported"],
["Q32","Crimea Scout, before combat, steals one random opponent combat card into your hand, once per combat, not per unit. Starting Coercion lets you spend one combat card once per turn as any one resource regardless of card value.","Crimea abilities.","supported"],
["Q33","Nordic Seaworthy lets character/mechs move to/from lakes and retreat to an adjacent lake instead of home; Polania Submerge lets character/mechs move to/from lakes and from any lake to any other lake, with no adjacent-lake retreat exception. ["Q34","Polania Camaraderie prevents popularity loss for opposing workers forced to retreat after you win combat as aggressor on your turn. It does not cover popularity loss for driving off undefended workers without combat.","Camaraderie.","supported"],

["Q37","Coins are not hidden information, but exact total need not be disclosed when asked. ["Q38","Only coins are tangible items exchangeable; agreements are informal and unenforceable (tournament play forbids even coin exchanges for deals/alliances). ["Q40","Count each unique qualifying feature across all structures; rivers do not break adjacency. Encounters count by printed location even when token removed; Mines are not printed tunnels. ["Q41","Structures on tunnels: printed tunnel territories (not Mines), 1=$2, 2=$4, 3–4=$6. Structures in a row: only longest continuous straight line, rivers do not break it; 1=$2, 2=$4, 3=$6, 4=$9. ["Q42","Yes. Winning attacker loses one popularity for each enemy worker forced to retreat, including workers carried by a defeated mech on a lake.","Combat step 6.","supported"],
["Q43","No. Star placement is permanent, but current popularity may later drop and determines final scoring. The summary says other players' stars do not block a goal, so two factions may each earn a star for the same achievement.","Stars and immediate end.","supported"],
["Q44","Deal one Faction Mat and one Player Mat randomly to each player. Seat factions in board order: Nordic, Rusviet, Crimea, Saxony, Polania clockwise, omitting inactive factions. ["Q45","River is a border between two land territories; lake occupies an entire hex and extends to every adjacent shoreline. A unit with applicable lake ability may enter from any surrounding land territory adjoining those shores.","Movement terrain rules.","supported"],
["Q46","No. Show encounter card to all when drawn, show its artwork, and read capitalized thematic text aloud; options need not all be read aloud.","Encounters.","supported"],
["Q47","No limit applies to friendly units or resource tokens on a territory.","Control, resources and home bases.","supported"],
["Q48","After current player starts a noninteractive bottom-row action, next clockwise player may begin their turn while current player decides which upgrade, mech, structure, or recruit to gain. Resolve interactive bonuses and game-end priority in order.","Turn Structure.","supported"],
["Q49","No. Top action once and bottom action once per turn; actions are limited to once within a turn even for Rusviet, though Rusviet may repeat a section. Costs paid once for action taken.","Turn Structure.","supported"],
["Q50","Normal Move alternative is gain $1 instead of moving.","Move OR coins.","supported"],
["Q51","No. Workers never return to Player Mat; producing workers come from Player Mat left to right. Retreat sends workers to home base, not Player Mat.","Produce; combat/worker retreat.","supported"],
["Q52","Yes. You may attack with zero power/popularity.","Combat.","supported"],
["Q53","Yes. May still fight after reaching combat-star limit; non-Saxony places no further combat stars after two.","Combat stars.","supported"],
["Q54","Must choose one affordable option if faction lacks Meander; cannot choose unaffordable coin/popularity option. Must pay printed cost but may take as little of chosen benefit as desired.","Encounters.","supported"],
["Q55","No: both combatants simultaneously and secretly select dial and optional cards. Reveal simultaneously after both choose.","Combat steps 1–3.","supported"],
["Q56","Announce the bottom-row action so neighbors can check recruit bonuses.","Bottom-row actions.","supported"],
["Q57","Star goals are placed as soon as achieved; stars are permanent and sixth immediately ends game, so you cannot delay/decline. Completed objective is different: may wait to reveal, but must meet all requirements at moment of reveal, and objective star occurs on reveal.","Stars; Objectives.","supported"],
["Q58","Normally units cannot cross rivers or enter lakes; faction/mech abilities provide exceptions.","Movement terrain rules.","supported"],
["Q59","No. Recruit is placed permanently on any open one-time recruit bonus on Faction Mat and cannot later move.","Enlist.","supported"],
["Q60","No. Only character triggers encounter; entering with a character stops movement and token is resolved after Move and combats if character remains.","Encounters.","supported"],

["Q62","Control a territory by having a unit there, or your structure there with no enemy unit. Resources alone do not establish/preserve control; leaving last unit with no structure means no stated control.","Control, resources and home bases.","supported"],
